baslik: The Biggest Explosion Before the Atomic Bomb

sahneler.metin: Before the atomic bomb, this was the largest explosion humans had ever made.
A cargo ship packed with wartime explosives collides with another vessel.
A fire starts on deck, and crowds gather at their windows to watch.
Then the ship detonates with the force of three kilotons of TNT.
A square mile of the city is flattened in an instant.
Nearly two thousand people die, and thousands more are blinded by flying glass.
A wall of water rises up and washes over the shore.
One collision became the deadliest blast of its entire age.
